newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Transaero begins Moscow-Hong Kong flights.
newsitem.headline: Russian Transaero begins Moscow-Hong Kong flights.

text.p: Private Russian air carrier Transaero will begin regular passenger service between Moscow and Hong Kong from next week, a company spokeswoman said on Thursday.
Natalia Aleksashina said Transaero would fly twice a month non-stop from July 20 operating DC-10-30 jets. "We plan to replace this plane with a Boeing 767 later," she said.
Transaero, expanding its service to the United States, also plans to begin regular passenger flights between Moscow and New York in August, but the spokeswoman did not give details.
The airline flies from Moscow to 29 cities in Russia, the Commonwealth of Independent States, Europe and the United States.
